summary: Learn to document, analyse and present agricultural programme data with Excel exercises and rural development reporting outputs. Explore the course.
lede: Agricultural data management, analysis and visualization helps rural development professionals turn farm, household and programme records into evidence for planning and reporting. It is designed for agricultural statisticians, monitoring officers and programme analysts who need to prepare and communicate programme results. Participants practise defining indicators, checking denominators and documenting data limitations, then use Excel to calculate measures, compare results across groups and periods, select charts and create a results brief.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, check, analyse or communicate agricultural and rural development data. It suits entry-level practitioners and colleagues moving into evidence and reporting responsibilities.
prerequisites: This foundation course suits you if you work with agricultural or rural development records and can interpret basic tables. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel; no add-ins are required.
